about_the_game:
Dice Goblin's Den is a 2D side-scrolling Tower Defense Roguelite game where you defend your fellow Goblins from waves of "heroes" who have been given quests at the local tavern to raid and loot your home! Gain new abilities as you unlock new classes by defeating enemy party leaders and reclaiming their loot! Learn the quirks of each class, and how their spells affect your units!

This game was developed by throwing a computer into a witch's cauldron on the night of a full moon, along with a pair of goblin ears and frog tongues for good measure.
